environment.version: PostgreSQL 17.6 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 15.2.0, 64-bit

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX supporter_active_name_trgm_idx ON public.supporter USING gin (name public.gin_trgm_ops) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX supporter_active_phone_trgm_idx ON public.supporter USING gin (phone public.gin_trgm_ops) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (phone IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX supporter_crm_assignee_active_idx ON public.supporter USING btree (crm_assignee_user_id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX supporter_deleted_at_idx ON public.supporter USING btree (deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX supporter_tags_gin_idx ON public.supporter USING gin (tags)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX supporter_email_key ON public.supporter USING btree (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX supporter_pkey ON public.supporter USING btree (id)

triggers.name: audit_supporter
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER audit_supporter AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.supporter FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_animal_mutation()

triggers.name: bump_supporter_edit_version
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER bump_supporter_edit_version BEFORE UPDATE ON public.supporter FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.bump_supporter_edit_version()

triggers.name: set_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.supporter FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_updated_at()

constraints.name: supporter_role_supporter_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (supporter_id) REFERENCES public.supporter(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX supporter_role_role_supporter_idx ON public.supporter_role USING btree (role, supporter_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX supporter_role_pkey ON public.supporter_role USING btree (supporter_id, role)

triggers.name: bump_supporter_edit_version_from_role
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER bump_supporter_edit_version_from_role AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.supporter_role FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.bump_supporter_edit_version_from_role()

triggers.name: set_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.supporter_role FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_updated_at()

constraints.name: consent_supporter_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (supporter_id) REFERENCES public.supporter(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX consent_supporter_channel_timestamp_idx ON public.consent USING btree (supporter_id, channel, "timestamp" DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX consent_dedup_unique ON public.consent USING btree (supporter_id, channel, status, source, "timestamp")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX consent_pkey ON public.consent USING btree (id)

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX audit_action_timestamp_idx ON public.audit_log USING btree (action, "timestamp" DESC)
